scope: Post-backfill quality sample (phases 1+2+3 complete). Read-only assessment via dev DB.

gates_pass.provenance_chain: full_text pubs all carry pdf_object_key + pdf_sha256 (3003/3003); 2967 objects 100% verified
gates_pass.chunk_integrity: 0 empty chunks, 0 tiny (<20 char) chunks, avg 994 chars
gates_pass.amendment_op_confidence: avg confidence >=0.70 per type; only 1 needs_review + 1 ambiguous of 10188
gates_pass.text_coherence: sampled section text is coherent, complete Hebrew legal prose (has_hebrew=100% on sample)

findings_text_fidelity.issue: Two-column gazette marginal section-captions (side headings) are interleaved into section body text by the flat pdf-parse text layer.
findings_text_fidelity.impact: Text is complete but not display-clean; extracted text is not yet presentable AS clean statutory text.
findings_text_fidelity.fix: Layout-aware extraction (column/x-band separation) or pdf.js text-layer geometry to isolate the marginal-note column.

findings_text_fidelity.issue: Glyph confusions on older font-encoded PDFs (e.g. daled/resh, nun/gimel; the 'TT: undefined function: 32' fonts).
findings_text_fidelity.impact: Occasional character errors in extracted text (e.g. 'meridat' for 'medidat', 'pagkas' for 'pinkas').
findings_text_fidelity.fix: Font-aware glyph remap / ToUnicode CMap handling; flag affected pubs for review.

findings_text_fidelity.issue: Section-number glitches from footnote digits gluing onto the section number (e.g. '1424' where section 142 has footnote 4).
findings_text_fidelity.impact: A small number of section canonical ids carry an incorrect numeric suffix.
findings_text_fidelity.fix: Strip trailing footnote-reference digits in the section-number parser using footnote-marker context.

findings_text_fidelity.issue: 10 Section entities have empty primary_text (0.75% of 1330).
findings_text_fidelity.impact: Minor — a few sections parsed to empty bodies.
findings_text_fidelity.fix: Filter/flag empty-body sections in the section parser.

findings_text_fidelity.issue: 81 full-text publications have stored bytes + SHA but a null source_url.
findings_text_fidelity.impact: Provenance display gap; the object is present and verified, but the origin URL was not recorded.
findings_text_fidelity.fix: Backfill source_url from law_publications.pdf_url / stored_objects.object_key where present.

findings_amendment_graph.issue: The amendment_operations unique key (publication_canonical_id, source_span_start, operation_type) collapses genuinely-distinct operations that share a clause start-offset and type. Across phases ~29k parsed ops persisted as 10188 (~60% dropped on ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Confirmed on high-volume laws (2000944: 2861 attempted -> 848 stored; 2000907: 1083 -> 328).
findings_amendment_graph.impact: Amendment graph is under-populated. Does NOT affect the PDF/text corpus or publish safety (ops are gated machine assertions).
findings_amendment_graph.fix: Add an additive deterministic op_fingerprint column = sha256(target_section|operation_type|old_text|new_text|source_span_start|source_span_end); make the unique key (publication_canonical_id, op_fingerprint); reprocess amendments from stored bytes to backfill dropped ops.

findings_cosmetic.issue: ingestion_checkpoints table has 0 rows — per-law checkpoint upsert silently no-ops. Resume works correctly via the 'laws already ingested' existence check, so non-blocking.
findings_cosmetic.fix: Diagnose the checkpoint upsert payload/constraint mismatch.

findings_cosmetic.issue: 7 legacy-type ops (commencement/amend_phrase/replaced_section/modified_section/change_effective_date) predate the KEEP_OP_TYPES filter.
findings_cosmetic.fix: One-off delete of non-KEEP legacy op types.

verdict.as_source_and_provenance_layer: PASS — official PDFs stored + 100% verified, text extracted and clearly labeled machine-derived, 100% labeled non-consolidated primary-official, fully gated unpublished.
verdict.as_display_ready_statutory_text: NOT YET — marginal-caption interleaving (F1) + glyph fidelity (F2) mean extracted text is not clean enough to present as authoritative law text.
verdict.publish_recommendation: KEEP unpublished. The source PDFs are authoritative and may be surfaced as source documents with machine-derived text labeled as such. Do NOT flip extracted text to published until F1+F2 are addressed and the amendment dedup key (A1) is fixed and reprocessed.
